schema_review.rationale: The shared s1300 -> s1400 -> s1401 chain covers installed 1.3.0 no-vector Server storage on SQLite, seekDB and OceanBase with Code disabled or enabled. SQLite/OceanBase Code caches remain separate. The seekDB Code extension freezes three exact tables and their indexes captured from the installed source wheel. The same core chain preserves these rows and initializes this extension for a new Code-enabled database; all existing revision checksums remain unchanged. Complete source/target and DDL-prefix validation include the extension. Startup and standalone Code initialization cannot add or repair managed Code objects. Existing managed storage without Code tables cannot enable the feature by changing a flag. Code-enabled installed acceptance on all three backends checks original fingerprints, symbols and immutable cache files; embedded acceptance additionally compares exact graph-table row digests and fresh/upgraded schemas. Strict Server admission remains intact; Server test fixtures initialize through a Server before SDK writes. Target locks, original recovery points, acknowledgements, historical authority and backup policies remain shared. Vector configurations and complete recovery/restore acceptance remain unfinished; release policy stays upgrade-required.
